results.reader_title: Exempting poorest exporters from EU carbon border charges raises WTO obstacles
results.reader_what: Trade-law researchers calculate limited aggregate climate costs of exemptions but identify difficult WTO compatibility questions.

results.reader_title: Dutch firms often implement sanctions more broadly than intended
